text: CATALOG LATENCY P0 - ROOT CAUSE FOUND, WITH FILE AND LINE. The founder reports 30-60s for the catalog on a phone and asks whether /research/early-access uses the new ~3-query bulk/cached path. ANSWER: IT DOES NOT. It still uses the old per-variant fan-out, and there is no cache anywhere on that path. Evidence, read not guessed: (1) server/research/index.ts:296 admits /early-access/catalog. (2) The route composes createProductionEarlyAccessCatalogSource (server/research/early-access/catalog/product-control-source.ts:390) whose declaredFacts is ProductControlDeclaredFactsReader over buildProductionVariantInventoryFactsReader. (3) server/research/early-access/catalog/declared-facts-source.ts:365 readProductFacts fans out per PRODUCT, line 370 Promise.all fans out per VARIANT into readVariantFacts, and each variant then awaits inventory (386), active holds (410), fulfillment fact (444), per-unit holds (471) and supplier confirmation (502). (4) THE REAL MULTIPLIER is one level deeper: server/research/catalog/member-catalog-service.ts inventoryFactsForVariant does ONE select from research_inventory_lots PER VARIANT (line ~198) and then Promise.all over EACH LOT calling db.rpc(research_lot_is_allocatable) - ONE RPC PER LOT (line ~209). So the cost is roughly (variants x 1 select) + (total lots x 1 RPC) + per-variant holds/supplier reads. Across ~420 variants that is thousands of round trips. This is the ~3,306-query path, still live, on the customer-facing Early Access catalog. (5) grep for cache/snapshot/swr across server/research/early-access/catalog/*.ts returns NOTHING - the 3-query + cache + stale-while-revalidate work landed on the PRICING lane (CatalogPricingProductSource / catalog-price-projection), not on the Early Access declared-facts projection. Those are two different readers and only one of them was fixed. WHO SHOULD FIX IT: server/research/catalog/member-catalog-service.ts is inside claude-fable-s7 CATALOG-ACTION-UNIFICATION lease, so I am NOT touching it. s7 - the two changes that matter are a BULK lots read keyed by variant instead of one select per variant, and replacing the per-lot research_lot_is_allocatable RPC with one set-based call, then a snapshot cache in front of the EA projection. Either alone is a large win; the per-lot RPC is almost certainly the dominant term. WHAT I AM DOING, in a path nobody owns: a regression test under server/research/early-access/catalog/ that counts reads through a counting fake and FAILS while the projection is O(variants) - so the fix has a red test to turn green and cannot silently regress. Will push and origin-verify. NOT claiming the fix itself. ALSO, CORRECTION TO MY EARLIER BROADCAST: I cited the peptide matrix at bb23f3a; 3e reports that SHA is superseded because it hardcoded 49.00/59.00 and picked a side in the live pricing dispute. Current head is 56e50542d2b421376d78e9ded667fe2d2078a8f7 on lane/peptide-acceptance-matrix, which asserts the invariant instead. Use that one.
